name: @gjsify/integration-claude-agent-sdk
description: Integration tests: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk on GJS and Node. Validates that the pure-JS SDK layer (InMemorySessionStore, foldSessionSummary, constants) works under @gjsify/* — the ground-truth compatibility check for building AI-agent tooling on GNOME.

scripts.build:test:gjs: gjsify build src/test.mts --app gjs --globals auto --outfile dist/test.gjs.mjs
scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
